His plan backfires when the young woman falls in love with him and the girl's brutish neighbor resents her lavishing attention on the youngest Cartwright.

programme.title: Bonanza Season 2 Episode 3 Badge Without Honor
programme.desc: A retired lawman arrives in Virginia City, but his presence stirs up trouble when a vengeful outlaw recognizes him from his past. programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First 1971

Packed with gritty shootouts, treachery, and Spaghetti Western style, this action-filled tale proves that in the West, the first to draw is the last to survive.
